summary.text: Myriad Mountain Ranges is Qing Yue An's immortal killer move. Phantom mountain ranges descend and encircle a target as if they were solid.

claims.text: Over Eastern Sea at night, Qing Yue An, Qing Yue clan’s first supreme elder, waits in the sky as rank eight Immortal Gu House Dragon Palace charges out of the sea. He mutters and waves his arms rapidly. A phantom mountain descends, the ranges extend far, and they encircle Dragon Palace; the house’s movement is obstructed and it crashes into the phantom like a solid mountain. Lone immortal Shi Miao, at rank eight, spat acid water that grew with the wind into a huge wave; the wave melted the phantom mountain like snow in the sun and opened a path, though Song Qi Yuan arrived before Dragon Palace could fully leave the encirclement.

In white heaven, after Song Qi Yuan finished destroying the mid and small stars he could sense, Qing Yue An cast again. The phantom image of countless mountains appeared, and the entire mountain range crashed into a giant star that served as a formation core among Heavenly Court’s scattered stars. The giant star was only an immortal material; under this rank eight killer move it shattered into star fragments.
